name: Clockwork Wagon

items.name: Hauler
items.text: This vehicle is designed to transport heavy cargo over long distances. It can hold 400 Bulk of cargo.

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.

items.name: Wind-Up
items.text: 1 hour of wind-up, 8 hours of operational time, DC 18, standby

text: A clockwork wagon is a slow, bulky wagon with cogs and gears running all along its interior and exterior, allowing it to pull about twice as much cargo as an ordinary wagon. However, it has less passenger space than an ordinary cart.
